name: Rogues

variantInfo.name: Rogue
notes: Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills; Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness holds the rogue spawns.
Magic and ranged defences are 0, so ranged or magic is fastest.
A level 135 Rogue variant (npc 6603) also exists; its stats are not captured here (honest UNKNOWN).
The Chaos Elemental roams the castle courtyard and can attack through walls - be cautious.

locationComparison.name: Rogues' Castle (Wilderness)
notes: Rogue spawns across the floors of Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness (~level 50+).
Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used.
The Chaos Elemental in the courtyard is a hazard and can attack through walls.

taskNotes: Rogues are a Krystilia (Wilderness) Slayer assignment: 75-125 per task, weight 5, no requirement.
slayerTargetId 269 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: worklist id table, 252-305); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
wikiPageId is null (honest UNKNOWN - not captured at authoring time); sourced from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rogue.
Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills. Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness is the target location.
The level 15 Rogue (npc 526) has 17 Hitpoints, grants 17 Slayer XP, defence level 13, and zero magic/ranged defence, so ranged or magic is fastest.
A level 135 Rogue variant (npc 6603) also exists; its combat stats are not captured here and are left UNKNOWN.
The Chaos Elemental roams the Rogues' Castle courtyard and can attack through walls; travel to the deep Wilderness carries high PKer risk.
No task extension unlock exists for Rogues.
recommendedMethod: Travel to Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness and kill the rogues with ranged or magic against their 0 magic/ranged defence. Watch for the Chaos Elemental and PKers; bring only cheap gear.
